verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (logo, headline, subcopy, CTA, pills, legal), but the flavour pills reverse the original order and have uneven widths and left edges (Blood Orange is narrower and inset). The GLACIER wordmark sits on the decorative circle, the left margin is tight, and the legal text runs into the bottom circle. B breaks the reading order by putting the oversized, heavily tracked GLACIER logo below the headline, where it competes with the headline. Its pills are shuffled, uneven in width and spread across large dead gaps, so the layout looks scattered rather than grouped.
